cards.title: Monthly membership
cards.description: Regular group classes according to the studio schedule.

cards.title: Private classes
cards.description: The programme and pace are tailored to the student's age, interests and creative goals.
cards.note: The package is valid for 2 months.

cards.highlight: The price depends on the chosen activity.

workshopPrices.title: Workshop prices
workshopPrices.description: Workshops are available for groups of at least 3 people. Prices are per participant.

workshopPrices.note: We confirm the final price and availability before booking.

camp.title: One day, a full camp session or just a workshop.
camp.description: Choose the most convenient option: the complete camp session, a single full day or only the creative part of the programme.

cards.title: Full camp session
cards.description: The child takes part in the complete programme of the chosen camp session.

cards.title: Full day
cards.description: You can bring your child for one full day of the camp programme.

cards.title: Workshop only
cards.description: The child joins only the workshop without taking part in the full-day programme.
